$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # ladder
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    script/both: evaluate is blocked: the lift parse failed on the case, and testdata/script/both.txtar, out/parse/error.txt, records its error.
    script/both: format is blocked: the lift parse failed on the case, and testdata/script/both.txtar, out/parse/error.txt, records its error.
    script/both: resolve is blocked: the lift parse failed on the case, and testdata/script/both.txtar, out/parse/error.txt, records its error.
    script/loop: evaluate is blocked: the lift resolve failed on the case, and testdata/script/loop.txtar, out/resolve/error.txt, records its error.
    script/stray: evaluate is blocked: the lift parse failed on the case, and testdata/script/stray.txtar, out/parse/error.txt, records its error.
    script/stray: format is blocked: the lift parse failed on the case, and testdata/script/stray.txtar, out/parse/error.txt, records its error.
    script/stray: resolve is blocked: the lift parse failed on the case, and testdata/script/stray.txtar, out/parse/error.txt, records its error.
